text:
**Jordi's deployment scope for the Zenod repository (zenod-ai/zenod) is limited to Zenod itself as the core librarian/Pinax unit.** Other agents in the suite are deployed separately with their own surfaces and do not run from the Zenod repo.

**Saved source (read directly):**
- `Projects/Zenod/Agent Suite Architecture.md` (current revision c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba) states:

  > "Zenod serves as the pure Pinax and entry-retrieval unit that controls writes into the repo/brain, preserves evidence, maintains the semantic Pinax and retrieves context for any target repository… A Zenod instance builds a personal-brain or project knowledge base around that repo and answers questions through its semantic index."

  The note then defines the separation:
  - Nearchus/Archus (backlog miner/planner) — separate deploy target (`archus.zenod.dev`), MCP server, limited to the central backlog repo (AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain) only.
  - Epaminon (execution commander) — separate unit for running approved work, code changes, and product-repo mutations.
  - Nectary and Mail — likewise distinct functional units, each with their own MCP surfaces.

The post-#411/#412 C1 boundary invariant (also recorded in the same note and cross-referenced in `Log/2026-07-02.md`) reinforces that product-repo writes (zenod-ai/zenod and similar) route exclusively through Epaminon/Codex execution; Archus is barred from them.

Thus only the Zenod core (librarian/index) is in-scope for the Zenod repository; the remaining agents are deployed as independent services.
